title: Vectors: SCHC-compressed OSCORE (per project-LICHEN-r9pz)
close_reason: SATISFIED and independently verified: canonical SCHC-OSCORE vectors for Rules 5/6 already present in test/vectors/schc_compression.json (oscore_linklocal, oscore_global per r9pz) plus malformed negatives rule5/rule6_nonzero_padding. Verified BOTH canonical vectors byte-for-byte against the normative FieldDescriptor tables (draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md sections 4.2/4.8, appendix-schc.md A.3/A.4) by hand-packing RFC 8724 MSB-first residue: HopLimit(8)|IID LSB(64)x2 or addr LSB(120)x2|portLSBs(4+4)|CoAP Type(2)+TKL(4)+Code(8)+MID(16)+2 pad bits -> tail bytes 33080448d0 + verbatim token/OSCORE-option/payload; spec-derived output equals committed compressed hex exactly. No code-under-test used as oracle. Consumers validated: python uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k 'schc_vector or all_schc_rules_covered' => 41 passed; cargo test -p lichen-schc --test shared_vectors => 3 passed (round-trip incl rules 5/6 + coverage assert 0..=7); C lichen/tests/schc/main.c registers both OSCORE tests. Fixed stale test/vectors/README.md row claiming 'rules 0-4' -> now documents rules 0-7 incl OSCORE 5/6. FINDINGS for open siblings 12.3.1/12.3.2 (implementation lane, not this vectors bead): (1) C test_oscore_global (main.c:193) compresses a ULA fd00::/64 packet under Rule 6, contradicting spec (Rule 6 matches Yggdrasil 0200::/8, LSB(120)); must be aligned to canonical oscore_global hex when C impl work lands; Zephyr suite not buildable on macOS host so left untouched. (2) Pre-existing unrelated pytest failures test_edhoc_vectors_match_generator and test_ccp9_rendezvous_vector[hash_based] (generator-drift in edhoc.json/ccp9-rendezvous.json lanes; zero interaction with schc_compression.json or README).
